{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df[df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999].shape[0]}')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check assay_batch distribution
print(f'Assay batch distribution:\n{df["assay_batch"].value_counts()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
print(f'\nMax sample_seq per patient:\n{df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().value_counts()}')"}
